title: VANDIRA Party & Alliance Intelligence Contract
scope: Uttar Pradesh Assembly Election 2027 political intelligence
principles: 2022 Assembly and 2024 Lok Sabha evidence remain separate
Historical performance is descriptive and is not a 2027 forecast
Current alliance or seat-sharing claims require fresh evidence
Primary official evidence outranks reported news when conflicts occur
No alliance is inferred merely from historical co-contesting or vote patterns
Party/candidate facts retain provenance and confidence
Sensitive voter attributes are not inferred or targeted
safety: Party and alliance analysis is organizational/political intelligence; do not infer sensitive personal attributes or use them for targeted persuasion.
